inputs.commit_message: Exclude Android local properties from generated knowledge
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('scripts/docs/fs-scan.ts')
s = p.read_text()
anchor = "const IGNORED_DIRECTORIES = new Set(["
if anchor not in s:
    raise SystemExit('ignored directory anchor missing')
s = s.replace(anchor, "const IGNORED_FILES = new Set(['android/local.properties']);\n\n" + anchor, 1)
old = "      const child = normalizePath(`${repoPath}/${entry.name}`);\n      if (child.startsWith('docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/')) continue;"
new = "      const child = normalizePath(`${repoPath}/${entry.name}`);\n      if (IGNORED_FILES.has(child)) continue;\n      if (child.startsWith('docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/')) continue;"
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('walk child anchor missing')
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
echo '=== clean baseline ==='
npm run docs:generate
git diff --exit-code -- docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated
echo '=== android/local.properties invariance ==='
printf 'sdk.dir=/tmp/fake-sdk\n' > android/local.properties
npm run docs:generate
git diff --exit-code -- docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated
rm -f android/local.properties
